summary: Regression sweep after style-only changes (AiAssistant message ids, Quotations line _key, typed forecast tests). Backend: full pytest suite 36/38 pass — the only 2 failures are the known/expected ones. Added /app/backend/tests/test_regress_schema_ai.py (5 tests) validating the TYPED forecast-vs-actual schema, quotation->forecast contribution (create/edit/lost/delete), and the /api/ai/chat SSE stream. Frontend Playwright: cookie-only login OK (localStorage empty), quotation drawer create/edit/delete OK, line-item key stability verified (mid-list remove/add keeps correct values), AI drawer streams a correct answer from Claude Sonnet 4.6. One new backend bug found: duplicate quotation_number returns 500 instead of 409.

critical.issue: Duplicate quotation_number hits the unique Mongo index and raises pymongo DuplicateKeyError -> unhandled 500 'Internal Server Error'. Should be caught and returned as 409/400 with a clear message. Same risk on PUT /api/quotations/{id} when renaming to an existing number. Reproduced by test_duplicate_quotation_number_not_500.

minor.issue: KNOWN/EXPECTED: no brute-force lockout — 6 wrong passwords all return 401 (test_brute_force_lockout fails). Out of scope per main agent.

KNOWN/EXPECTED: stale seed assertion — test_sales_forecast.py::TestForecastVsActual::test_consolidation_from_sales_forecast asserts total_actual.Revenue == 4,621,778 but live DB is 4,622,776.74 (QA data drift). NOTE: the drifted assertion now lives in test_sales_forecast.py, not backend_test.py::TestReports::test_summary_totals (that one passes). Update the expected value or compute it from /api/transactions.

ui_bugs.issue: Assistant reply is rendered as raw text, so markdown emphasis shows literally: '**Total actual revenue: Rs 46,21,777.74 (~Rs 46.2L)**'. Render markdown (or strip ** ) in the bubble.

issues: After clicking a line's remove button, focus falls back to the drawer container (document.activeElement = q-drawer) instead of an adjacent input. Values are correctly preserved by the new _key, but keyboard users lose their place — consider focusing the next row's description input after removal.

Pre-existing from iteration_2 and still present: q-date uses the native browser date picker (type=date) instead of the shadcn Calendar; Recharts still logs repeated 'width(-1) and height(-1)' warnings on mount.

action_items: Wrap quotation insert/update in try/except pymongo.errors.DuplicateKeyError and return HTTP 409 'quotation_number already exists' (currently 500).
Fix the stale expected total in test_sales_forecast.py::test_consolidation_from_sales_forecast (4,621,778 -> derive dynamically) OR restore the seed; it is the only remaining data-drift failure.
Render markdown in the AI assistant bubble (currently shows literal ** ).
Optional: restore focus to a sibling line input after removing a quotation line.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py create_quotation/update_quotation: no duplicate-key handling despite a unique index on quotation_number — only 500-producing path found in this sweep.

_q_totals mutates a dict keyed by ln['type'] with t.get(typ, 0) — an unknown type string from the payload silently creates a new bucket and skews net; validate type against Revenue/Cost/Expense in QuotationLineIn (Literal or validator).

Quotations.jsx line 322 still keeps the `|| `idx-${idx}`` fallback for key — harmless, but since emptyLine() always sets _key it is dead code except for rows loaded from the API; make the mapping in the edit path guarantee _key so the fallback can be dropped.
server.py is 896 lines — approaching the point where routers (auth/transactions/quotations/reports/ai) should be split into modules.
achievement_pct returns None when forecast is 0 — frontend must guard; verified schema-wise but worth an explicit 0/null contract note.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of regression scenarios (1 cosmetic markdown issue)

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_QA_* quotations (backend + UI TEST_QA_UI_1). Verified 0 leftovers; quotations collection back to 1 seeded doc (Q-2026-DEMO-01). 10 rows now in ai_messages from the AI stream tests (harmless chat history).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Contracts to remember: POST/PUT /api/quotations body uses quotation_number/client_name/lines (NOT quote_number/customer/line_items). POST /api/ai/chat body is {message, session_id?, year?} and streams SSE 'data: {"delta":...}' then {"done":true}. In forecast-vs-actual rows, line_items[type] is an INT COUNT, not a list. After login the app lands on '/' (not '/dashboard') — do not wait_for_url('**/dashboard**'). Quotation delete uses a window.confirm, so register page.on('dialog', accept) first. New regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_regress_schema_ai.py.
rca_of_the_issue: No regressions from the style-only changes. Verified the stable-key refactor behaviourally: with 3 lines (A/B/C) filled, removing row 0 leaves desc0='Line B', desc1='Line C', amt0='2000' and adding a line afterwards leaves existing rows untouched — i.e. no stale-value bleed that index keys would cause. AI SSE verified twice: backend stream returns text/event-stream with json deltas in ~5s, and the drawer renders the answer. The only genuine defect surfaced is unhandled DuplicateKeyError on quotation_number (unique index created in startup), which turns a user retyping an existing quote number into a 500.
